status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/rnd-maps/proposed_items.json; each gap is also a named gap of the answer that needs it.

gaps.name: Portal R&D project and task (client + formula, status, waiting on, owner)
gaps.ontology_today: RelPublicAppProject and RelPublicAppProjectTask are declared not served; open projects come only from Mission Control tasks.

gaps.name: R&D KB Board (Planner tasks per client and formula)
gaps.ontology_today: No Planner capture; the board is the closest thing to a log and is read by nobody.
gaps.dot_question: Which Planner plan holds the R&D KB Board, and may a GET-only Graph reader capture its tasks and buckets?

gaps.name: Teams message text in the projection (a body property on TeamsChatMessage and TeamsChannelMessage)
gaps.ontology_today: Teams messages are projected with time, sender, subject and attachments; the body is cited, not projected, so agenda lines show no message text (binding_expected body_preview).

gaps.name: Agenda record (meeting date, sections, lines linked to their records, review edits)
gaps.ontology_today: The agenda exists only as Word, Canva and a posted PDF; no record keeps one draft or its edits.
gaps.dot_question: Where would the reviewed agenda be stored once Word and Canva retire, and who publishes it?

gaps.name: Sample request and sample receipt (requester, project, amount wanted, based on, supplier code, received amount and unit)
gaps.ontology_today: RelPublicAppSourcingRequest and RelPublicAppSourcingSample are not served; requests live in FileMaker email, direct email and Teams.

gaps.name: Lab batch usage per sample (actual grams per line drawn from a receipt)
gaps.ontology_today: No usage record exists anywhere: amounts are in handwritten notes, so quantity left is usage_not_recorded.
gaps.dot_question: Where will formulators record actual grams per batch line once the portal lab batch exists, and does it name the sample container used?

gaps.name: FileMaker R&D formulas (formula number, product name, legacy number, formula lines)
gaps.ontology_today: The formula_code identifier kind names public.formula as its carrier with served false; Formulation is not served, so an IL's formula number is named but not verified and its ingredients cannot be checked.

gaps.name: Ingredient list keyed by formula number (one IL record per version, its files as attachments)
gaps.ontology_today: An IL is a SharePoint file named by product; its formula number is read from the file name only, and copies are told apart only by content hash.
